```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

The simulated data is generated and then exported as a CSV file. 

```{r}
# Generate all original VAR/VARX datasets using the same seed and formulas
source("00_requirements.R")
set.seed(92507)

# Simulation values
n <- 200 # Num of observations kept
# VAR(1) has p^2 = 400 possible coefficients
p <- 20 # Num of time series
burn_in <- 200 # Early obs discarded to reduce startup effects

############ Transition matrices ############

# Start with a p x p identity matrix
A_base <- diag(1, p)

# Add lagged relationships above the diagonal
for (i in 1:(p-1)){
  A_base[i, i+1] <- 0.25 # First superdiagonal
}

# Weak vs. strong lagged effects (also changes signal size)
A_weak <- 0.2 * A_base
A_strong <- 0.8 * A_base

# Stability check: largest absolute eigenvalue must be < 1
# Find eigenvalues, take absolute values, then find max
max(Mod(eigen(A_weak)$values))
max(Mod(eigen(A_strong)$values))

############ Exogenous effects ############

# No outside effect for regular VAR
B_none <- rep(0, p)

# Weak Z effect for Y1 and Y3 only
B_weak <- rep(0, p)
B_weak[1] <- 0.2
B_weak[3] <- 0.15

# Strong Z effect for Y1 and Y3 only
B_strong <- rep(0, p)
B_strong[1] <- 0.7
B_strong[3] <- 0.5

total_n <- n + burn_in

# Same independent N(0,1) shocks across all scenarios
errors <- matrix(rnorm(total_n * p),
                 nrow = total_n,
                 ncol = p)

# Generate lagged outside variable: Z[t] = 0.4*Z[t-1] + noise
Z <- numeric(total_n)
Z[1] <- rnorm(1, sd = 1 / sqrt(1 - 0.4^2))

for (t in 2:total_n) {
  Z[t] <- 0.4 * Z[t - 1] + rnorm(1)
}


############ Generate datasets ############

# Function to generate VAR or VARX data
source("01_funct_GenerateSimData.R")

# 1. VAR: Weak lagged effects; no outside effects
data_VAR_weakDEP <- sim_data_VARX(A_weak, B_none, Z, errors, burn_in)
# 2. VAR: Strong lagged effects; no outside effects
data_VAR_strongDEP <- sim_data_VARX(A_strong, B_none, Z, errors, burn_in)
# 3. VARX: Weak lagged Y and weak Z effects
data_VARX_weakDEP_weakEXO <- sim_data_VARX(A_weak, B_weak, Z, errors, burn_in)
# 4. VARX: Strong lagged Y and weak Z effects
data_VARX_strongDEP_weakEXO <- sim_data_VARX(A_strong, B_weak, Z, errors, burn_in)
# 5. VARX: Weak lagged Y and strong Z effects
data_VARX_weakDEP_strongEXO <- sim_data_VARX(A_weak, B_strong, Z, errors, burn_in)
# 6. VARX: Strong lagged Y and strong Z effects
data_VARX_strongDEP_strongEXO <- sim_data_VARX(A_strong, B_strong, Z, errors, burn_in)

# Saving the original simulation objects for later Rmd files
dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save(n, p, burn_in, total_n, A_base, A_weak, A_strong,
     B_none, B_weak, B_strong, Z, errors,
     data_VAR_weakDEP, data_VAR_strongDEP,
     data_VARX_weakDEP_weakEXO, data_VARX_strongDEP_weakEXO,
     data_VARX_weakDEP_strongEXO, data_VARX_strongDEP_strongEXO,
     file = "data/simulation_objects.RData")
```
